subject: note:family_court_workbench_relocation_20260912
title: Family Court Workbench imported as a Propria project
summary: Verified 2026-09-12: root-level FL-MCP was the Propria-owned Family Court Workbench Tauri application, not a shared MCP service. It had no Git repository. Its 96 non-generated source/configuration files and existing local generated tree moved together to projects/family-court-workbench. The 26,679 dependency/build files remain ignored and are not intended for Git. FL-MCP is now a Windows junction to the canonical path for compatibility. No content was deleted. From the canonical path, 14 sidecar tests and 8 UI tests passed under a 2 GiB Node heap ceiling. External installed-launcher verification remains separate. SUPERSEDED 2026-09-18 (owner: Propria is the project): moved back to root FL-MCP/ with git mv; projects/ retired.
rationale: The owner designated Propria as the monorepo root. This application had no independent history and its actual package identity made projects/family-court-workbench the least ambiguous target.
